tools.name: validate_code
tools.description: Check the format and check digits of one identifier: IBAN (ISO 13616, per-country length and layout), BIC/SWIFT (ISO 9362 format and country), EU VAT number (offline checksum, VIES not queried), GTIN/EAN-8/UPC-A/EAN-13/GTIN-14 (GS1 mod 10) or ISBN-10/13. type "auto" (default) detects the type from t

tools.name: get_meta
tools.description: Return the service version and build, supported IBAN and VAT countries, GTIN formats, the disclaimer and the current limits. Does not count as a check. Read-only. Same data as GET /v1/meta.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "validate_code" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: validate_code · Public sink: validate_code · Destructive: validate_code.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: validate_code · Public sink: validate_code · Destructive: validate_code

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
